name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Consultative Sales Professional & Trusted Advisor
summary: Quota-carrying consultative sales professional with 15+ years closing high-stakes purchase decisions for individuals and businesses, from small-business owners investing in new systems to multi-stakeholder buying groups. Skilled at building trust fast on a single call, navigating budget-sensitive conversations with every decision-maker in the room, and converting warm, high-intent leads into signed commitments, evidenced by 120% of sales targets at Wix and a top-three sales ranking at Accelo while quota doubled.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery calls to surface goals, budget, and priorities before recommending a path forward.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, consultatively recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with each client's real objectives.
Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners, producing consistent messaging and closing new service engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Advised client businesses on ad-spend budget planning and allocation, guiding sensitive spend conversations to a confident decision.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into recommendations for varied audiences.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client concerns promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Closed 6 new-client deals during tenure, averaging ~$22K each (several exceeding $25K), roughly $130K+ in total bookings.
Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, from first conversation through signed commitment and delivery.
Built and refined internal processes that improved handoff accuracy and cross-team alignment on client commitments.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Closed and launched 25+ clients per month over video consultations, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site strategy and goals with each client's vision, building trust quickly on a single call.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), coaching sales conversations and close technique.
Drove a 25% improvement in conversion rates across supported accounts through proactive communication on client goals and concerns.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8-15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
Closed deals of $20K and larger later in tenure, mixed with a base of smaller wins.
Sold and scoped complex software to agencies and professional-services firms, building trusted-advisor relationships with C-suite decision-makers.
Consistently performed above commission floor into accelerator tiers, averaging ~$17,750/month in bookings (~$213K annualized) plus new recurring revenue.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform targeting SMB owners, from first conversation to close.
Built the consultative approach to trust-building and technology adoption that carried into every later sales role.
